whatItDoes.text: Nike designs, develops, markets and sells athletic footwear, apparel, equipment, accessories and services worldwide.
whatItDoes.quote: Our principal business activity is the design, development and worldwide marketing and selling of athletic footwear, apparel, equipment, accessories and services.

whatItDoes.text: Nike sells its products under the Nike, Jordan and Converse brands.
whatItDoes.quote: We offer our products under the NIKE, Jordan and Converse brands.

competitiveEdge.text: Nike says it is competitive in all of its product and market areas.
competitiveEdge.quote: We believe that we are competitive in all of these areas.

marketPosition.text: Nike states it is the largest seller of athletic footwear and apparel globally.
marketPosition.quote: NIKE is the largest seller of athletic footwear and apparel in the world.

biggestRisks.text: Nike warns its products, services and experiences face intense competition.
biggestRisks.quote: Our products, services and experiences face intense competition.

biggestRisks.text: Nike says failing to respond quickly to consumer trends could hurt sales and profits.
biggestRisks.quote: Failure to respond in a timely and adequate manner could have a material adverse effect on our sales and profitability.

upcoming.text: Nike plans to organize into three geographies in fiscal 2028.
upcoming.quote: NIKE plans to organize into three geographies in fiscal 2028

source.label: 10-Q filed October 2, 2026 · Part I Item 2, Management's Discussion and Analysis

dropped.text: Nike generates revenue by selling products through its own stores and digital platforms and through wholesale accounts worldwide.
dropped.quote: We sell our products through NIKE Direct operations and to wholesale accounts worldwide.

dropped.text: Nike notes the athletic footwear, apparel and equipment industry is highly competitive worldwide.
dropped.quote: The athletic footwear, apparel and equipment industry is highly competitive on a worldwide basis.

dropped.text: Nike says sports popularity and shifting consumer preferences drive demand for its products.
dropped.quote: The popularity of sports and fitness activities and changing consumer preferences affect demand for our products.

dropped.text: Nike expects its actions to reignite brand momentum and reposition the business for long‑term shareholder value.
dropped.quote: We believe these actions will reignite brand momentum and reposition our business to drive long-term shareholder value.

dropped.text: Nike expects its cost‑saving program to deliver about $2.5 billion in cumulative savings through fiscal 2031.
dropped.quote: The program is expected to deliver approximately $2.5 billion in cumulative savings through fiscal 2031.
